name: Sippai
title: Philistine giant from the lineage of Rapha
summary: Sippai was one of the Philistine giants descended from Rapha. He was defeated by Sibbekai from Husah in one of David's wars against the Philistines, and thus the Philistines were subdued.

keyEvents.title: Defeated in war against the Philistines
keyEvents.description: Sippai, one of Rapha's descendants, was killed in battle at Gezer, and the Philistines were humbled.
